13 / E-commerce & catalog

Guraba — A global e-commerce and sales ecosystem

Web, mobile and a Telegram bot — one account, one cart.

Year
2026
Scope
E-commerce & catalog
  • 3
    sales channels — web, mobile, Telegram
  • 2
    admin panels — web and mobile
  • ms
    cross-channel stock sync

01 / Overview

Guraba is more than a standard e-commerce site. It combines a website, a mobile app and a Telegram bot into one multi-channel sales ecosystem. Its main strength is a dual admin architecture: sales, stock and users are managed from both a full-featured web panel and a dedicated admin mobile app.

02 / The problem

A customer fills a cart on the site, asks questions on Telegram, then downloads the app — and has to start over on every channel. The store owner has to sit at a computer to approve orders.

03 / Our approach

All channels sit on a single API, so accounts and carts are identical across web, mobile and the bot. The database is hybrid: financial transactions and stock live in MSSQL with ACID guarantees, while thousands of clicks and logs per second are written asynchronously to MongoDB.

04 / The result

Stock changes reach every channel within milliseconds and are pushed to the admin app. The store owner approves orders from a phone, and the customer continues on whichever channel they prefer.

05 / Key features

What it does.

  • 01

    Multi-channel sales

    Order through the website, the mobile app or the Telegram bot, with the same account and cart.

  • 02

    Mobile admin management

    Approve orders, add products and view analytics from a phone.

  • 03

    Global and hybrid payments

    Apple Pay, Google Pay and Web3 / cryptocurrency integration.

  • 04

    Automated Telegram bot

    Search products, add them to the cart and track order status inside the chat.

  • 05

    Big-data analysis

    User behaviour, search history and logs analysed for marketing.

06 / Architecture

How it is built.

  1. Hybrid database

    Financial transactions and stock in MSSQL with ACID; thousands of clicks and logs per second written asynchronously to MongoDB.

  2. Real-time ecosystem sync

    Web, mobile, bot and admin panels talk through one API, so a stock change appears on every channel instantly.
